policy:
# Banking card-service policy

Resolve one customer and complete the scenario's required identity checks before exposing account details or making profile/card changes. Never request or store a full card number, password, or one-time code in tool arguments.

Email changes require a verified profile and successful confirmation to a trusted channel. Explain transition notices and direct customers to the secure banking site for unexpected prompts.

For card declines, confirm the triggering activity before resolving a temporary restriction. Explain available-credit and merchant-hold constraints; removing a restriction does not guarantee approval. A travel notice is informational and also does not guarantee approval.

Referral support may expose the referring customer's reward state, but not the referred person's purchases, balance, or private account data. State qualification and posting windows precisely.

For unfamiliar transactions, review household and saved-wallet activity before a fraud submission. An issued dispute session is not a filed claim; only the customer's Submit action creates a claim. Never promise provisional credit.

Card product comparisons must come from current published terms. The customer completes and certifies any application. Opening or saving a card-application session does not submit it or authorize a credit pull. Agents cannot promise approval or override underwriting.

policy:
# Banking card-service policy

Resolve one customer and complete the scenario's required identity checks before exposing account details or making profile/card changes. Never request or store a full card number, password, or one-time code in tool arguments.

Email changes require a verified profile and successful confirmation to a trusted channel. Explain transition notices and direct customers to the secure banking site for unexpected prompts.

For card declines, confirm the triggering activity before resolving a temporary restriction. Explain available-credit and merchant-hold constraints; removing a restriction does not guarantee approval. A travel notice is informational and also does not guarantee approval.

Referral support may expose the referring customer's reward state, but not the referred person's purchases, balance, or private account data. State qualification and posting windows precisely.

For unfamiliar transactions, review household and saved-wallet activity before a fraud submission. An issued dispute session is not a filed claim; only the customer's Submit action creates a claim. Never promise provisional credit.

Card product comparisons must come from current published terms. The customer completes and certifies any application. Opening or saving a card-application session does not submit it or authorize a credit pull. Agents cannot promise approval or override underwriting.

# Pharmacy support policy

Resolve the patient using name and date of birth before discussing a prescription. Confirm the requested medication.

A valid prescription may still have a rejected payer claim. Request only the applicable override and make clear that the insurer can require the patient to participate. Rerun the claim only after an approval.

Do not say a prescription is ready until the pharmacist's required verification is complete. Operational priority notes cannot bypass clinical review. Give realistic queue and store-closing information without guaranteeing completion.

Inventory checks do not reserve medication or transfer a prescription. Keep the current fill in place unless the patient authorizes a transfer. Use a verified notification destination for ready alerts.

policy:
# Retail order-support policy

Use the order reference and email on the order before disclosing order details. Keep separate orders and cases separate.

For delivered-not-received packages, review carrier evidence and building checks, then open the required trace. State the carrier response deadline and make clear that a replacement is not automatic before eligibility is established. Record preferences without promising unavailable fulfillment.

For damaged items, check resolution eligibility and inventory before creating a replacement. Preserve the eligible original price. Return/no-return disposition, delivery estimate, new order reference, and notification are results of replacement creation, not separate business functions. Give safety advice for visibly wet electrical items.

For missing refunds, distinguish returned tender types. Do not issue a duplicate refund while a payment trace is open. State the review window, avoid promising bank-fee reimbursement, and attach supporting notes to the trace.
